title: Further substantial composition genera (matter/form; integral parts) rejected
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Ye THIRD genus belonging toward substantial composition that from matter plus form is. But that composition upon God does not fall. Ye FOURTH genus belonging toward composition that by which a substance from integral parts is. Ye FIFTH genus belonging toward substantial composition from ye actual plus ye potential is. But these upon God do not fall, because by open Scripture plus reason they are refuted.
pass_b_english: The THIRD genus of substantial composition is that from matter and form. But that composition does not fall upon God. The FOURTH genus of composition is that by which a substance is from integral parts. The FIFTH genus of substantial composition is from the actual and the potential. But these do not fall upon God, because they are refuted by open Scripture and reason.
source_text: TERTIUM compositionis substantialis genus est, quo ex materia & forma. At ista compositio in Deum non cadit. QUARTUM compositionis genus, quo substantia ex partibus integralibus. QUINTUM genus compositionis substantialis est ex actuario & potentiali. Haec autem in Deum non cadunt, quia aperta Scriptura & ratione refutantur.
